entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I've reconsidered my opinion of you,[n]Inmate!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The look on your face seems to be that[n]of a man who has accomplished a great[n]deed.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: To think you would use the trap set[n]against you to entrap them...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I've never seen a dramatic resurgence[n]such as that.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Truly marvelous—those are the only[n]words I can think of to describe you.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: We should be thanking you for[n]entertaining us thus.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Perhaps this was easy for you?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Well then, if there is another[n]opportunity... I shall present[n]them at that time.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: There should be no one left to hinder[n]your rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: That is... if everything goes well,[n]without any problems.
